sn13.11:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso sinerussa pabbatarājassa satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhipeyya.
sn13.11:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yā vā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā yo vā sineru pabbatarājāti.
sn13.11:2.1: etadeva bhante bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ sineru pabbatarājā
sn13.11:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti sineruṃ pabbatarājānaṃ upanidhāya satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇa sakkharā upanikkhittāti.
sn13.11:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa adhigamaṃ upanidhāya aññatitthiyasamaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakānaṃ adhigamo neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti.
sn13.11:3.2: evaṃ mahādhigamo kho bhikkhave diṭṭhisampanno puggalo evaṃ mahābhiññoti.
sn13.11:4.4: tayo ca pabbatūpamāti. abhisamayasaṃyuttaṃ paṭhamaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
